headline: Rate hikes lift earnings and FFO despite softer occupancy
summary_short: Q2 2026 diluted EPS was $0.50 (+19.1% y/y, -10.7% q/q) on revenue of $397.8M (+5.6% y/y); FFO per share rose to $0.77 from $0.69 y/y, while Core Portfolio average occupancy slipped to 93.8% from 94.3%.
summary_long: Revenue grew 5.6% y/y to $397.8M as MH base rents and Core Annual RV/marina rents rose on rate increases (5.8% and 5.4%), partly offset by lower Seasonal/Transient RV occupancy. Core Portfolio average occupancy eased to 93.8% from 94.3%, mainly from 503 expansion sites added since Q2 2025. Net income rose 19.2% y/y to $99.5M, helped by a $7.1M hurricane-related insurance recovery reimbursing capex. FFO per share rose to $0.77 from $0.69; Normalized FFO/share, excluding that recovery, rose 7.7% to $0.74. Operating expenses grew a slower 2.9%. ELS consolidated its remaining RVC joint-venture interests, adding $103.3M to gross real-estate investment. No forward guidance was issued. Total assets: $5.80B; $372.4M of undrawn credit-line capacity.
